name: shva
description: Shiva Kakkar's personal Claude Code plugins. Cross-cutting tools that aren't tied to any single product — vocabulary briefings, prompt scaffolds, LinkedIn authoring with Shiva's voice, and personal workflow accelerators.

plugins.name: shva
plugins.description: Personal command + skill pack. v0.9.4 adds two reading skills: book-taste-curator, which scores prospective books against a codified taste profile, and search-books, which answers from the owned book corpus over the shivas-book-search MCP with book-level citations.
